description: Bid for the billboard slot and optionally post a message in the same transaction. The bid must be at least 1% over the current amount; the displaced poster gets their stake back plus half the increase, the creator gets the other half; acquiring clears the message. Defaults bid_sol to the minimum. Always call read_billboard first and try dry_run: true before bidding. The server enforces MAX_BID_SOL and DAILY_CAP_SOL before signing and logs every outcome with your reasoning. Under AUTO_BID=false this returns status "proposed" with a proposal_id and signs nothing; call approve_proposal to sign.

bid_sol.description: Bid in SOL as a decimal string, e.g. "0.105". Defaults to the current program minimum (1% over the current amount, rounded down). Must be within MAX_BID_SOL and DAILY_CAP_SOL.

dry_run.description: When true, compute every figure and sign nothing. Works in read-only mode. Use it before a real bid.

message.description: Message to post once the slot is yours. Acquiring clears the previous message. Measured in UTF-8 bytes (max 4096); longer messages are sent as several transactions.

reasoning.description: Why you are doing this, in plain language. Written verbatim to the operator activity log beside the transaction signature. Required. At most 2000 characters.

name: acquire_posting_rights

bid_sol.description: The bid this call evaluated (given, or the minimum).

expires_at.description: Set when status is "proposed": the proposal cannot be approved after this time.

if_outbid_at_minimum_you_receive_sol.description: What you get back if someone later outbids you at the minimum.

anyOf.description: Spend-limit check for this bid. Null in read-only mode (no limits configured).

ok.description: Whether the bid is within MAX_BID_SOL and DAILY_CAP_SOL right now.

previous_holder_receives_sol.description: Refund to the displaced poster: their stake plus half the increase.

proposal_id.description: Set when status is "proposed": pass it to approve_proposal to sign.

reason.description: Human-readable detail for refused and failed outcomes.

sandbox.description: True when BILLBOARD_SANDBOX is on: a simulated board, an ephemeral wallet, no real SOL and nothing on-chain. False on the real billboard.

signatures.description: Transaction signatures, in the order they landed.

you_are_poster.description: True when the wallet already holds the slot; use append_message instead.

title: Acquire posting rights
